# relay_database (Resource)

A managed database cluster. Creating, updating and destroying wait for the cluster to settle. Changing `name`, `engine` or `workspace_id` replaces the cluster and its data; use `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "relay_database" "billing" {
  workspace_id = relay_workspace.prod.id
  name         = "billing"
  engine       = "postgresql"
  version      = "17"

  nodes = [{
    role     = "data"
    count    = 2
    provider = "aws"
    region   = "us-east-1"
    resources = {
      cpu     = "2"
      memory  = "8Gi"
      storage = "100Gi"
    }
  }]

  postgresql_parameters = {
    work_mem = "64MB"
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "45m"
  }

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) `postgresql` or `mongodb`.
- `name` (String) Cluster name, unique in the workspace.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Node groups. Storage can only grow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `version` (String) Engine version. It cannot change here: major upgrades go through Relay's upgrade flow, and a plan that changes it fails.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace the cluster belongs to.

### Optional

- `backups_enabled` (Boolean) Scheduled backups.
- `default_connections` (Attributes) Relay-managed users and connections seeded once the cluster is ready. Create-only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_connections))
- `keep_backups_on_destroy` (Boolean) Keep the cluster's backups when it is destroyed.
- `params` (Map of String) Engine parameters.
- `postgresql_parameters` (Map of String) PostgreSQL settings (GUCs). An empty map resets them to defaults; omitting the attribute leaves them unmanaged.
- `replication` (Attributes) PostgreSQL replication tuning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--replication))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_host` (String) Primary endpoint host.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Primary endpoint port.
- `id` (String) Database ID.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase after the last apply.
- `phase_message` (String) Detail for the phase.
- `private_endpoints` (Attributes List) Private endpoints by role, when private access is enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_endpoints))
- `public_endpoints` (Attributes List) Public endpoints by role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_endpoints))
- `ready_nodes` (Number) Nodes ready.
- `total_nodes` (Number) Nodes expected.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Required:

- `count` (Number) Number of nodes.
- `provider` (String) Infrastructure provider.
- `region` (String) Provider region.
- `resources` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--resources))
- `role` (String) Node role, for example `data`.

Optional:

- `tags` (Map of String) Engine-specific labels for every node in the group.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.resources`

Required:

- `cpu` (String) CPU request, Kubernetes quantity.
- `memory` (String) Memory request, Kubernetes quantity.
- `storage` (String) Volume size, Kubernetes quantity.

Optional:

- `iops` (Number) Provisioned IOPS.
- `storage_class` (String) Storage class. Defaults to the platform's.
- `throughput` (Number) Provisioned throughput.



<a id="nestedatt--default_connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_connections`

Optional:

- `admin` (Boolean)
- `readonly` (Boolean)
- `readwrite` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--replication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `replication`

Required:

- `mode` (String) `async` or `synchronous`.

Optional:

- `synchronous_replicas` (Number) Synchronous replicas when `mode` is `synchronous`.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import relay_database.billing <workspace_id>/<database_id>
```
